underlying_goal: Implement observability configuration for ECK Elasticsearch Exporter with environment-specific values files for prod and dev, including proper authentication to the ECK-managed Elasticsearch cluster
friction_detail: Initial implementation omitted ECK authentication, causing HTTP 401 errors that required user to report and trigger a follow-up fix.
brief_summary: User asked to implement ECK Elasticsearch Exporter observability config with env-specific values; Claude created the files but missed authentication, then debugged and planned the fix after user reported 401 errors.
